description: This file defines the class `SugarWidgetFieldRelate`, which extends `SugarWidgetReportField`. It provides methods for rendering HTML inputs, constructing database queries, and filtering related records within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. The class is specifically used for handling 'relate' field widgets in reports and dashlets.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldRelate
classes.description: A widget class for rendering and managing relate fields in reports and dashlets within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Returns HTML for a select input element configured for relate field selection.

methods.name: displayInputQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns an SQL query to fetch possible relate field options.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Generates a SQL condition for filtering records where relate field IDs start with certain criteria.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Creates a SQL condition for filtering records based on specific related record IDs.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Returns plain display value for list views, considering custom link configurations.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML for list view display with a link to the detail view, considering custom link configurations.
